run_ensemble_experiment: run a BenchMARL ensemble experiment with MADDPG agent and ISAC adversary on the VMAS simple_tag task
create_experiment_config: create an ExperimentConfig by loading from the base_experiment YAML configuration file
create_ensemble_algorithm_config: create an EnsembleAlgorithmConfig with MADDPG for the agent and ISAC for the adversary
load_vmas_task: load the VMAS simple_tag task configuration from its YAML file using VmasTask
load_mlp_model_config: load an MLP model configuration from the YAML config file using MlpConfig
